Decision priority: (1) if grounded and stalled_frames is at least 3, choose RIGHT_RUN_JUMP; (2) if enemy_ahead and nearest_enemy distance_pixels is at most 160, or its estimated_contact_frames is at most 18, choose RIGHT_RUN_JUMP or RIGHT_JUMP; (3) if grounded and jump_must_start_now is true, obstacle_distance_tiles is at most 2.5, or gap_distance_tiles is at most 3.5, choose RIGHT_RUN_JUMP or RIGHT_JUMP; (4) if airborne and a hazard is near, keep RIGHT_RUN_JUMP so the jump input is held through landing; (5) otherwise, on clear flat ground, choose RIGHT_RUN. Do not choose RIGHT_RUN when blocked or when a jump is needed. Obstacle/gap tile distances are coarse scan columns, not exact pixel clearance. The option descriptions define the exact game input mapping.

options.description: NOOP: apply no directional or jump input; preserve momentum.
RIGHT: hold right at walking speed without starting a jump.
RIGHT_RUN: hold right at running speed without jumping; use only on clear flat ground.
RIGHT_JUMP: hold right and start a normal jump to clear a low obstacle or enemy.
RIGHT_RUN_JUMP: hold right at running speed and start a jump; use for a pipe, pit gap, approaching enemy, or a stalled wall, and keep this input while airborne until landing.
JUMP: start a vertical jump without choosing a horizontal direction.
LEFT: hold left at walking speed to backtrack; do not use to advance toward the goal.
